translatedData.content:
October CPI came in above expectations on both measures: headline +0.4% month over month (market expected +0.3%, prior +0.6%), and core +0.3% (expected +0.2%). Core has been 0.3% for three consecutive months—August, September, and October were identical, which annualizes to 3.7%.

Breaking it down, energy wasn’t what beat expectations. Energy rose just 0.7% (versus 5.2% in September), and retail gasoline fell 4% in October, but the seasonally adjusted gasoline component actually edged up. So let’s stop telling the “cooling oil prices” story this time around. What really drove the numbers was food +0.5% (food at home +0.4%, food away from home +0.5%) and shelter +0.3% (accounting for more than 30% of the monthly increase). The only categories that fell in this report were used cars and communications. Core inflation is sticky in services, not goods.

One more detail worth noting: because last year’s shutdown meant there was no data collection for October 2025, the BLS couldn’t even publish the year-over-year figure this time. This kind of “month over month but no year over year” CPI report is extremely rare. With the reference point gone, the only thing the market can price is inflation’s momentum.

The transmission to $BTC  runs through the denominator: sticky core inflation → higher expectations for short-term rates in December → real rates and the dollar rise together → discount rates on risk assets go up, with crypto—the asset with the longest duration—taking the first hit. This isn’t the intuition that “high inflation means buy safe havens”; it’s a liquidity discount. The reverse is true as well: if core really returns to 0.1–0.2%, it doesn’t mean inflation is over; it means investors are once again willing to pay a premium for long-duration assets.

Tonight already gave us an answer: when the data came out at 21:30, BTC fell from 74,410 to around 73,740 in two minutes, about -0.9%. In the 21:30 minute, 917 BTC traded, while the preceding few minutes saw only 3–7 BTC per minute. The first sellers were trading the denominator, not the narrative.

One question to leave you with: Waller made his position clear in London before the market opened—if core month-over-month inflation is 0.3% or higher, a 50 bp move in December should be considered. This report landed right on that threshold, while the market has already priced in a 25 bp move on December 9 with 100% certainty, so the only remaining incremental risk is “50 bp.” Are you betting on 25 or 50? I’m betting on 25: shelter fell from 0.4% to 0.3%, used cars and communications are down, and food looks more like a one-month jump. But if you think that 0.4% increase in food at home is the real signal, then 50 bp is no longer a tail-risk scenario.

content:
10 月 CPI 两个数都超预期：环比 +0.4%（市场预期 +0.3%，前值 +0.6%），核心 +0.3%（预期 +0.2%）。核心是连续第三个月 0.3%——8 月、9 月、10 月一模一样，折年就是 3.7%。

拆开看，超预期的不是能源。能源只涨 0.7%（9 月是 5.2%），零售汽油 10 月还跌了 4%，但季调后的汽油分项反而微涨——所以这轮别再拿"油价降温"讲故事了。真正顶着的是食品 +0.5%（其中家庭食品 +0.4%、外食 +0.5%）、住所 +0.3%（贡献了月度涨幅三成以上）。这份报告里唯一在跌的是二手车和通信。核心的黏性在服务，不在商品。

还有个细节值得记一下：因为去年停摆缺了 2025 年 10 月的采集，BLS 这次连同比都发不出来，这是极少见的"只有环比、没有同比"的 CPI。参照系一掉，市场能定价的只剩一个东西——通胀的动量。

传到 $BTC 走的是分母端：核心黏住 → 12 月短端利率预期上移 → 实际利率和美元同步抬 → 风险资产的贴现率上去，加密作为最长久期的资产先被打折。这不是"通胀高=买避险"的直觉，而是流动性折价。反向同理：核心若真回到 0.1-0.2%，不是通胀结束了，是资金重新给长久期资产付溢价。

今晚已经给过一次答案：21:30 数据落地，BTC 两分钟内从 74,410 掉到 73,740 附近，约 -0.9%；21:30 那一分钟成交 917 枚 BTC，而前几分钟每分钟只有 3-7 枚。先手卖的是分母，不是叙事。

留个问题：Waller 盘前在伦敦把话说明白了——核心环比 0.3% 或以上，12 月就该考虑加 50bp。这份数据正好踩在线上，而 12 月 9 号加 25bp 市场已经 100% 定价，所以增量风险只剩"50bp"这一个。你押 25 还是 50？我押 25：住所从 0.4% 降到 0.3%、二手车和通信在跌，食品更像单月跳升；但如果你认为家庭食品那 0.4% 才是真信号，那 50bp 就不算尾部事件了。

title: 🚨 CPI 今晚 21:30 公布！核心通胀 0.2% 还是 0.3%，0.1% 决定 12 月加息 25 还是 50 个基点
subTitle:
BTC 现在 $74,253，卡在 7.5 万美元下面整整一天。

今晚 21:30，一个数字定方向：美国 10 月 CPI。

这不是普通的 CPI。这次没有同比数——去年 10 月政府停摆，劳工统计局没采到价格，所以这份报告只给环比。市场没了同比这个锚，只能盯着环比核心通胀的小数点后一位做文章。而美联储理事沃勒已经把线画好了：核心 CPI 如果达到 +0.3%，50 个基点的加息就该摆上桌面；如果只有 +0.2%，25 个基点仍是大概率。

预期值恰好卡在中间：环比 +0.3%、核心 +0.2%。0.1 个百分点，决定的是加息 25 还是 50 个基点。

📊 数据一览（截至 2026-11-10 约 21:25，北京时间）

- BTC：$74,253，24h -0.44%，30 天 -9.78%；今日区间 $74,116–$75,568；市值约 $1.48 万亿美元；较 10 月 6 日历史高点 $126,080 低约 41%（CoinGecko / Finnhub）
- ETH：$2,095.85，24h -1.0%；SOL $84.68，24h -2.0%（CoinGecko）
- BTC 资金费率：约 +0.0089%/8h，多头还在付费，但全市场 OI 加权资金费率年化约 10.8%，已回到约 11%/年的中性基线，杠杆并不拥挤（CoinGlass / Oracle of BTC）
- BTC 永续持仓：约 $520 亿美元；全市场期货持仓约 $521.6 亿，较 10 月 27 日已去杠杆约 4.5%（CoinGecko / Oracle of BTC）
- 爆仓：过去 24 小时全网约 $2.69 亿美元，多单占约 65%（CoinGlass，约 06:10 UTC）；远低于周末闪崩当天的超 $10 亿美元
- 恐惧贪婪指数 32，恐惧区间（Alternative.me）
- ETF：11 月 9 日 BTC ETF 净流出 $2.01 亿美元，IBIT 流出 $2.132 亿、连续第 7 个交易日流出；上周净流出 $12.8 亿美元，7 月初以来最大单周（Farside，经 CoinDesk）
- 美股盘前：道指期货 +0.33%–0.37%、标普 500 期货 +0.05%–0.12%、纳指 100 期货 -0.21%–0.39%；周一三大指数刚大涨 2.15%–2.74%（TipRanks / CNBC）
- 10 年期美债收益率约 4.89%；12 月加息概率约 80%–85%（CME FedWatch / 路透）

先看位置。BTC 周收约 $74,850，连续第五周收阴，收在 50 周均线（约 $75,500 附近）下方。周日最低打到约 $73,510，今天白天最高只回到 $75,568，收复乏力。价格卡在 50 周均线、整数关口 $75,000 和周日低点 $73,510 之间，窄幅磨了一整天——典型的事件前走势：没人愿意在数据公布前下重注。

再看杠杆。周末那波超 $10 亿美元的爆仓已经把最脆弱的多头洗出去了：现在资金费率回到中性基线附近，持仓两周去杠杆约 4.5%，过去 24 小时爆仓只有 $2.69 亿美元。翻译一下：市场里已经没有多少"等着被清算"的杠杆了，今晚 CPI 无论往哪边走，都不太会复制周日那种踩踏式清算。这是个好消息，也是个坏消息——好消息是下行有缓冲，坏消息是也没有被迫平仓带来的反弹燃料。

真正的分水岭在 ETF。上周 BTC ETF 净流出 $12.8 亿美元，昨天又流出 $2.01 亿美元，IBIT 已经连续 7 个交易日净流出。这是趋势的锚：美国机构买家还没回来。CPI 只能决定今晚价格往哪边跳，决定不了趋势——没有 ETF 资金回流，任何一次 CPI 带来的反弹都先当反抽看。

三种情形，提前想清楚：

第一，核心 +0.2% 或更低，符合预期：50 个基点的选项出局，短线 relief 反弹，第一目标是站回 50 周均线约 $75,500 上方。站不稳，就还是弱势里的反抽。

第二，核心 +0.3%：触发沃勒的 50 个基点讨论，加息预期升温，$73,510 的周日低点大概率再次被测试。

第三，核心高于 +0.3%：最坏的情形，12 月加息 50 个基点的定价会快速升温，风险资产全线承压。

我的观点：今晚的胜负手不是 BTC 本身，是核心通胀小数点后一位。但比 CPI 数字更值得盯的，是明后天 ETF 的资金流——CPI 决定今晚的波动，ETF 决定这轮调整什么时候结束。在 IBIT 停止流出之前，任何反弹我都先当反抽处理，不追。

⚠️ 风险提示：CPI 公布前后波动可能剧烈，杠杆仓位面临双向挤压；BTC 仍在 50 周均线下方，弱势结构未改；ETH 24h 跌 1.0%，弱于 BTC；本次 CPI 无同比数，市场对环比读数的解读会被放大；英伟达调查事件尚未完全消化，若美股 AI 龙头再度走弱会拖累风险资产情绪。以上只是市场观察，不构成任何投资建议。

Tonight at 21:30, one number sets the direction: U.S. October CPI.

This isn’t an ordinary CPI report. There’s no year-over-year figure this time—last October, the government shutdown prevented the Bureau of Labor Statistics from collecting prices, so this report gives only the month-over-month change. Without the year-over-year figure as an anchor, markets can only scrutinize the core inflation figure to one decimal place. Fed Governor Waller has already drawn the line: if core CPI comes in at +0.3%, a 50-basis-point rate hike should be on the table; if it’s only +0.2%, a 25-basis-point hike remains the most likely outcome.

title: 🚨 BITCOIN AT A CRITICAL MOMENT: Will US Inflation Trigger the Next Big Crypto Move?
subTitle:
The crypto market is watching one important event today, and it could bring a major shift in market sentiment.💥💥💥😱
Bitcoin investors are waiting for the US October CPI inflation report. But why is this economic data so important for Bitcoin and the entire crypto market?

Let’s break it down. 👇
🇺🇸 1. Why Today’s CPI Report Matters
The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures how quickly prices are increasing across the economy.
Today’s report is important because inflation directly influences expectations around Federal Reserve interest rate decisions.
And here’s the connection:
Higher inflation can keep interest rates elevated.Elevated rates can put pressure on risk assets.Lower inflation could improve investor confidence.Better market sentiment could support Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.
According to economists’ estimates, headline CPI is expected to rise 0.3% month-over-month, while Core CPI is expected to increase 0.2%.
The actual numbers and their difference from expectations will matter.

📉 2. What Happens If Inflation Comes in Higher?
Imagine inflation comes in hotter than expected.
This could create another challenge for crypto investors.
Potential consequences:

Investors may become more cautious.Expectations of tighter monetary policy could increase.Selling pressure could return to Bitcoin.Altcoins could experience higher volatility.
However, a bearish reaction is not guaranteed. Markets can sometimes move differently depending on what investors have already priced in.
📈 3. What If Inflation Comes in Lower?
This is the scenario Bitcoin bulls would probably welcome.
If inflation comes in below expectations:
Market sentiment could improve.Expectations of easier monetary policy may strengthen.Buyers could return to risk assets.Bitcoin may attempt a recovery.
But remember: One positive inflation report does not automatically mean a new bull run.
🔍 4. Three Things I’m Watching
Instead of blindly predicting the next move, I would focus on these three factors:
1. Bitcoin ($BTC )
Can Bitcoin reclaim important resistance levels, or will sellers remain in control?
2. Ethereum ($ETH )
Can Ethereum show relative strength against Bitcoin and defend important support?
3. Market Volume
Will the market confirm the move with strong trading volume, or will it turn out to be a temporary reaction?
🎯 5. My Market View
I believe this is a moment to observe rather than rush into a trade.

A hotter CPI reading could increase downside risks, while a cooler reading could provide relief to the market.
But the real direction will depend on the actual data, market expectations, liquidity and price confirmation.

The smartest move is not always predicting the direction. Sometimes it’s waiting for confirmation.

🟢 BULLISH: Bitcoin will recover and buyers will return.
🔴 BEARISH: Bitcoin will face another correction.
🟡 NEUTRAL: The market will remain sideways.

【ETH is down 8% in a week. Has it bottomed out?】

ETH fell 8.2% in a week, and quite a few people say it has entered value territory. I disagree: a sharp drop is a price fact, not evidence of a reversal.

I’m leaning toward sideways movement over the next 7 days, for three reasons. The price is now near support at 2041.8, where there’s some buying interest for now; the Fear & Greed Index is at 32, and its weekly average is also 32, so fear isn’t getting worse; and PNC is testing a service that lets eligible business and institutional clients receive USDC on Ethereum and deposit it at a rate of 1 coin to 1 US dollar.

If that last development takes hold, who will it affect? Bank payments, corporate settlements, and stablecoin channels. The business logic also makes sense: institutions connect to the existing dollar system, while Ethereum provides the settlement rails. But a pilot is still a long way from widespread adoption, so it can’t be taken as a direct reason to buy ETH.

What would make me change my view? A decisive, high-volume break below 2041.8, and I’ll turn bearish; a quick move above 2191.16 that holds, and I’ll turn bullish.

Do you think this is a bottom forming, or a pause before another leg down? Come back next week and we’ll see.

My view? ➡️ Sideways

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn't happen in an instant; it's a process. Understand how it works, and you'll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds used to open a position. For example, with 10x leverage, it's 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts sending “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: When losses eat into your maintenance margin, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What’s the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you’ll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross Margin】All the balance in your account is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you’re less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in extreme market conditions, losses could wipe out your entire account. It’s like putting all your eggs in one
They support each other in the same basket.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept inside a cage.

【My advice】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you’re not yet able to assess “the worst-case scenario for a single bad trade

First, let’s look at the complete, disclosed fund-flow data: In Farside’s table of U.S. spot Ethereum funds, net outflows on November 5, 6, and 9 were approximately $99.9 million, $93.3 million, and $184.6 million, respectively, for a cumulative total of about $377.8 million. On November 9, the daily figure was mainly made up of net outflows of about $119.3 million from BlackRock ETHA and about $20.8 million from ETHB, among others; some individual funds still saw inflows, so it’s inaccurate to say that all products were redeemed at the same time. The November 10 entry is still a dash for now; the displayed zero does not mean it has been confirmed that there were no fund flows today.

Three consecutive days of outflows mean traditional accounts are reducing their ETH exposure, which could weigh on marginal buying during a rebound. But fund subscriptions and redemptions don’t run on the same clock as individual spot trades on exchanges, and the $377.8 million cannot be directly translated into a specific price drop. Ethereum also has distinct sources of demand, including staking, on-chain collateral, and corporate treasuries, so fund data is only one piece of the puzzle. I previously wrote that the November 9 flow figures were gradually being completed. This time, I’m confirming only the cumulative figure for three complete trading days, not treating preliminary figures from when data was missing as final. If the data is revised later, the updated table should be treated as authoritative.

The macro catalyst has not yet materialized either. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics’ schedule states that October CPI will be released at 21:30 Beijing time tonight. The market’s inflation forecast is an expectation, not an actual figure, and one CPI release should not be presented as a direct indication of the Federal Reserve’s December decision. If inflation is higher than expected, interest rates and the dollar could put pressure on ETH’s valuation; if it’s lower than expected, risk appetite could rebound, but bond yields and prices still need to be monitored for a sustained response. This is a judgment about the mechanism, not a description of a market reaction that has already occurred.

At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance is around $2,098, down about 1.19% over 24 hours, with a range of approximately $2,084 to $2,152. ETH is close to the day’s low. The outflow backdrop is consistent with the current price weakness, but it is not enough to prove that $2,084 will break. $2,084 is the immediate support level, around $2,124 is the 24-hour opening area, and $2,152 is the day’s high. If ETH quickly reclaims $2,124 after the CPI release and holds above it, the one-sided bearish view would be weakened. If it falls below $2,084 and then fails to reclaim it on a rebound, we’ll have to acknowledge the increased downside risk. A brief spike during the data release does not count as a valid breakout.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t participate now or bet on the data with high leverage. I’d wait for at least the initial volatility to subside after the CPI release. Only if ETH then gets back above $2,124 and holds $2,115 on a retest would I consider a conditional spot long, capped at 4% of my total capital. The first target would be $2,152; I’d take half off there and close the remaining position around $2,185. If the price fell back below $2,080 after entry, I’d exit immediately with a stop-loss. If ETH first loses $2,084 and cannot reclaim $2,100 on a rebound, I’d cancel the long plan, stay in cash, and avoid averaging down against the trend. All prices are conditional levels and risk boundaries. None of these conditions has been triggered, and I’m not counting this plan as profit.

我的态度是谨慎偏弱，今晚不凭一条“机构抛售”标题追空。币安广场正在讨论#CPITestsDecemberRateOutlook，ETH也在Most Searched名单里。先看已经完整披露的资金事实：Farside的美国现货以太坊基金表中，11月5日、6日、9日三个交易日合计净流出分别约9990万、9330万和1.846亿美元，累计约3.778亿美元。11月9日单日主要由BlackRock ETHA约1.193亿美元净流出、ETHB约2080万美元净流出等构成；个别基金仍有正流入，不能说所有产品同时被赎回。11月10日这一行目前还是横杠，显示的零并不等于今日已经确认没有资金流动。

连续三日流出意味着传统账户对ETH敞口在缩减，可能压制反弹时的边际买盘；但基金份额申赎与交易所现货逐笔成交并非同一个时钟，也不能把3.778亿美元直接换算成某个必跌价格。尤其以太坊还叠加质押、链上抵押品和企业财库等不同需求，基金数据只是资金拼图的一块。此前我写过11月9日流量逐步补齐，这次只确认三个完整交易日的累计值，不把先前缺项时的暂列数当成最终数。若后续数据修订，也要以表格更新为准。

宏观催化同样尚未落地。美国劳工统计局日程写明10月CPI在北京时间今晚21:30公布。市场对通胀的预测属于预期，不能提前写成实际值，更不能把一次CPI直接写成美联储12月的决定。若通胀高于预期，利率和美元可能给ETH估值带来压力；若低于预期，风险偏好可能反弹，但仍要观察债券收益率和价格是否持续响应。这是机制判断，不是已经发生的市场反应。

截稿时币安ETH/USDT约2098美元，24小时下跌约1.19%，区间约2084至2152美元。ETH已靠近当日低点，资金流出背景与现价偏弱一致，但并不足以证明2084必破。2084是眼前防守位，2124附近是24小时开盘区域，2152是当日高点。若CPI后快速收复2124并稳住，单边偏弱判断会被削弱；若跌破2084后反抽仍站不回，则要承认新的下行风险。数据公布前的瞬间针刺不作为有效突破。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与，也不以高杠杆赌数据。只有CPI公布后至少等待急波动消化，ETH重新站上2124且回踩守住2115，我才考虑总资金最多4%的现货条件多单；目标先看2152，到那里减仓一半，余仓在2185附近平仓。入场后若跌回2080下方，直接止损平仓。若先失守2084且反抽不能回到2100，我取消多单计划，保持现金，不逆势摊低成本。所有价格都是条件和风险边界，目前没有触发，也没有把计划算作盈利。

以太坊市场深度分析：机构流出与技术破位下的困境与机遇

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十日中午，以太坊报价约两千零九十三美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点三，盘中一度触及两千零九十一美元的日内低点。价格已经跌破了七周期、二十五周期和九十九周期指数移动平均线组成的均线簇，同时跌穿了布林带下轨，技术形态呈现明显的破位下行格局。

从均线系统来看，短期均线持续向下发散，价格运行在所有主要均线下方，空头趋势明确。近期以太坊的弱势不仅源于自身基本面变化，更受到整体加密市场情绪低迷的拖累。人工智能板块代币集体暴跌约百分之三十，进一步加剧了市场对成长型加密资产的抛售压力。

二、技术指标解读

移动平均收敛发散指标已确认看空交叉，空头动能持续释放。相对强弱指标方面，短期数值已回落至偏低区域，显示卖压较为集中。布林带下轨已被跌破，价格进入技术性超卖区域，但尚未出现明显的止跌信号。

量化因子分析显示，十五个因子中看空与看多信号交织，但综合指标仍偏向下行。值得注意的是，相对强弱指标十四周期因子发出了少数的看多信号，表明在极度超卖后可能存在技术性反弹的动能积累。然而，在价格重新站回指数移动平均线簇之前，整体趋势仍应以看空对待。

三、市场情绪分析

机构资金持续流出是当前以太坊面临的最大压力来源。十一月九日，以太坊现货交易所交易基金录得一点八四六亿美元净流出，这已经是连续第三日出现资金外流，三日累计流出超过一亿八千万美元。机构产品的持续赎回反映出大型资金对短期市场前景的谨慎态度。

基本面方面，以太坊基金会钱包的持续减持以及治理诉讼带来的不确定性进一步削弱了市场信心。网络层面的变化同样值得关注，随着二层网络迁移加速，主网销毁费用下降超过百分之九十九，长期通缩支撑逻辑正在被弱化。这对以太坊的价值捕获能力构成了结构性挑战。

此外，以太坊联合创始人维塔利克公开支持放缓人工智能数据中心建设，虽然这一表态本身具有合理性，但客观上打击了与人工智能叙事相关的加密资产，而以太坊生态中不乏此类项目。这种叙事层面的降温进一步加剧了市场的悲观情绪。

综合来看，以太坊短期内面临机构流出、技术破位和叙事降温的三重压力。价格需要关注两千美元整数关口的支撑力度，若该位置失守，可能引发更深层次的调整。投资者在当前环境下应保持谨慎，等待明确的止跌信号和资金流向逆转后再考虑布局。

$SNDKB: Liquidity Tier Effects on Slippage and ATR

A common assumption is that lower liquidity always produces higher slippage, and that the average true range (ATR) will rise proportionally. The observation for the primary asset shows an hourly direction down with volume above baseline, while peer ETH also moves down but with strong volume, and peer INIT moves down with weaker volume. This contrast creates a thought experiment about how ATR reacts across tiers.

The counterexample considers that even with higher volume, a thinly traded coin can display a modest ATR if price moves stay within a narrow band. Conversely, a highly liquid asset may exhibit a larger ATR when a sudden shift overwhelms market depth. The hourly ATR reading for the primary asset uses 5.79679, while peers display their own 5.79679 values that are not directly comparable because liquidity conditions differ.

What could change the reading is a shift in order flow that expands the effective spread, causing slippage to grow faster than ATR. To reassess, one could monitor the relative volume 2.75056 alongside the ATR on an hourly chart and note when the spread widens beyond the typical 5.79679 range. This self‑check highlights the limits of assuming a fixed relationship between slippage and ATR across liquidity tiers. 🙂

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

For a wider view: $ETH has hourly direction down and volume above its baseline; $INIT has hourly direction down and volume not above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.

📰 America’s largest county embraces BTC for tax payments: Why can local governments’ digital currency experiments succeed?

Miami-Dade County, Florida, has decided to accept Bitcoin payments for property taxes, becoming the third county-level jurisdiction in the United States to allow taxes to be paid in cryptocurrency. The policy is expected to encourage more local governments to follow suit, giving cryptocurrencies a wider range of real-world uses while also easing barriers that traditional payment methods pose for some people.

Why does this news matter?
The main motivation for local governments to accept Bitcoin for tax payments is to improve the efficiency of public services, particularly for taxpayers in remote areas or with limited access to financial services. Miami-Dade County is the fourth-largest metropolitan jurisdiction in the United States. Accepting Bitcoin means that at least several million dollars in taxes could be collected through cryptocurrency channels each year. The potential to scale this experiment is reflected in several ways:
- It bypasses regulatory restrictions and transaction fees associated with the traditional banking system, making it especially helpful for taxpayers without bank accounts
- Tax revenue itself will not decrease as a result of adopting a new payment method; it simply gives taxpayers more ways to pay
- It reflects the scope for local governments to innovate independently amid uncertainty over federal regulations, and their approach may differ from that of state governments (such as Florida’s recently crypto-friendly stance)

Market impact
- In the short term, it will encourage real-world uses for Bitcoin, particularly in high-frequency, essential-use cases like tax payments
- In the long term, the experience gained from policies like this could serve as a reference for expanding cryptocurrency payments at the state and even federal levels
- It may have a marginal effect on market sentiment, but will not cause a structural shock because the total amount of tax revenue will remain unchanged
- Relevant historical examples include El Salvador’s adoption of Bitcoin as legal tender (a failure) and cryptocurrency payment pilots in countries such as Sudan (with limited results)

Trading strategy
💡 Miami-Dade County’s experiment gives BTC a new real-world-use narrative, signaling that the currency is gradually gaining ground in public services. If more local governments follow suit, it could prompt institutional investors to reassess Bitcoin’s status as legal tender. In the short term, however, it is more important to focus on the direct impact of global macroeconomic capital flows on prices. This rationale would no longer hold if regulators moved in the opposite direction and tightened restrictions—for example, by introducing new rules that limit the scope of cryptocurrency payments.

📰 美国最大县花落BTC缴税：为什么地方政府的数字货币试验能成？

佛罗里达州迈阿密-戴德县决定接受比特币支付房产税，成为美国第三个允许加密货币缴税的县级行政区。这项政策预计将吸引更多地方政府效仿，为加密货币提供更广泛的实际应用场景，同时也能缓解传统支付方式对部分民众的门槛限制。

为什么这条新闻重要？
地方政府采用比特币缴税的核心驱动力在于提升公共服务效率，尤其是针对偏远或流动性不足的纳税人。迈阿密-戴德县是美国第四大城市辖区，采用比特币意味着每年至少有数百万美元的税款可以通过加密货币渠道收取。这种试验的扩展性体现在：
- 它绕开了传统银行体系的监管限制和交易费用，尤其对无银行账户的纳税人更友好
- 税收收入本质不会因采用新支付方式而减少，只是渠道更多元化
- 体现了地方政府在联邦监管不确定性下的自主创新空间，与州政府的态度可能存在差异（如佛罗里达州近期对加密货币的友好立场）

对市场的影响
- 短期看，将刺激比特币的实际应用场景，尤其是在税务这类高频刚需场景
- 长期看，这类政策积累的经验可能成为未来州级乃至联邦层面推广加密货币支付的参照案例
- 对市场情绪有边际影响，但不会形成结构性冲击，因为税收总额不变
- 可参考的历史案例包括萨尔瓦多的比特币强制货币地位（失败）和苏丹等国的加密货币支付试点（效果有限）

操作思路
💡 迈阿密-戴德县的试验为BTC提供了新的实际应用叙事，意味着该币种在公共服务领域的渗透正在逐步落地。如果未来出现更多地方政府跟进，可能推动比特币在机构投资者认知中重新评估其"法偿性"维度，但短期内更应关注全球宏观资金流动对价格的直接影响。如果监管层面出现反向收紧（如新规定限制加密货币支付范围），这个逻辑作废。

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

Looking at the decline over a longer period: the 30-day high was 84898, the current price is 74309, and the low reached 73510—a total pullback of 11388 points, or 13.4%. The last 10 daily closes, in order, were 78354 → 76816 → 77454 → 80504 → 76088 → 75844 → 75868 → 74851 → 75368 → 74309. That move to 80504 was a classic bull trap; since then, price has stair-stepped lower, with each rebound peaking below the previous one.

📉 4-hour: Moving averages are exerting even more pressure
MA20 is 75258, MA50 is 76581, and MA100 is 77979—again, a fully bearish alignment. The last five 4-hour closes were 75368 → 74562 → 74849 → 74420 → 74309, with each rebound weaker than the last. The 4-hour RSI is 37.6, still in weak territory. The price range over the last 20 four-hour candles is 73510-76250, and price is currently hugging the bottom of the range.

📉 ETH is worse: 4-hour RSI at 25.1, deeply oversold
ETH’s 4-hour MA20 is 2172.8 and MA50 is 2244.4, both above the price of 2090. But the RSI has already fallen to 25.1—the most oversold reading since this decline began. The technical implication is straightforward: the short-term drop has been too rapid, creating the potential for a technical rebound. But oversold does not mean a bottom is in; it only means the pace of the decline may need to correct.

🔑 Key levels: Three lines
First, 73510. This is the low for the current decline and the lowest level in nearly 30 days. A break below it would leave little obvious technical support underneath; the next psychological levels are 73000, then 72000. Holding here would keep the range-bound structure intact.
Second, 76198. Applying Fibonacci retracement to the decline from 84898 to 73510 puts the 0.236 level at 76198. Meanwhile, the daily MA7 is 76119 and the 4-hour range high is 76250. These three levels converge in the 76100-76250 zone, forming the strongest resistance band overhead. A rebound is likely to meet resistance here unless it breaks through on strong volume.
Third, 75258. This is the 4-hour MA20 and the first nearby resistance. If price cannot reclaim it, the short-term move cannot even be called a rebound—it is merely sideways trading.

Further up, the 0.382 retracement level at 77860 is almost exactly aligned with the 4-hour MA100 at 77979. If price can actually reach this area, the move would shift from a rebound to a trend recovery.

📊 Scenario analysis
Scenario 1 (more likely): The 73510-76250 range continues. A daily RSI of 31.6 and ETH’s 4-hour RSI of 25 provide potential rebound momentum, but the confluence of resistance at 76198 is formidable. Price will most likely consolidate between 74000 and 75500 while waiting for a new macro catalyst.

⚙️ Volume notes

Technically, a decline on lower volume suggests selling pressure is fading, but it also indicates a lack of buyers stepping in. When volume dries up completely, an “unconfirmed rebound” often comes first, followed by a directional move. So until volume picks up noticeably, any breakout in either direction should be viewed with caution.

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1,000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you earn 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U of principal and open a position with 10x leverage, you actually control
a 1,000U position. If the price rises by 1%, you earn 10% on your principal; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note that the loss is calculated based on your total borrowed position.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact threshold also depends on the margin ratio).

🚨 💥🚨 Ethereum's $38.4 Billion Liquidity Drain: What the KelpDAO Exploit Reveals About DeFi’s Infrastructure Risk

For traders and market analysts, the KelpDAO exploit on April 18, 2026, serves as a stark reminder that smart contract security is only half the battle. While the initial exploit drained roughly $292 million, the true macroeconomic fallout is measured by a staggering $38.4 billion contraction in Ethereum's stablecoin and tokenized-fund market cap between April and November 2026.

Key Takeaways from the Exchange Desk:
👉The 1-of-1 DVN Vulnerability: The exploit bypassed traditional smart-contract bugs entirely. Attackers compromised internal RPC nodes and executed a DDoS attack, forcing a LayerZero Decentralized Verifier Network (DVN) configured in a vulnerable 1-of-1 setup to accept forged state data and mint 116,500 unbacked rsETH.

👉Aave’s Liquidity Crunch: The forged assets were deposited into Aave as collateral to borrow real ETH before oracles updated. This triggered an intense bank run, causing Aave's TVL to plunge 33% within 72 hours and leaving liquidity so depleted that USDT pool availability dropped to a critical $2,540.

👉Macro Capital Flight: Ethereum's stablecoin and tokenized-fund market cap fell from $206.7 billion to $168.3 billion (a 19% drop). Rather than a localized incident, capital fled Ethereum entirely or rotated toward alternative networks like Tron (+24.07% 30-day TVL change) to escape shared infrastructure risks.

👉Permanent Risk Repricing: Although the "DeFi United" coalition and protocol teams successfully closed the financial shortfall and recovered assets, liquidity has not returned. Aave's TVL remains heavily depressed, signaling that market risk appetite has permanently repriced structural infrastructure vulnerabilities.

From its weekly close of 2,727 at the end of September, it has fallen about 22% in total. Over the same week, BTC fell about 4.5% and SOL about 8.5%. content:
ETH 连收五根周阴线，ETH/BTC 跌到 7 月中旬以来最低周收：我不把它当“补涨候选”

常有人问：BTC 都跌了，ETH 跌得更多，是不是更该先抄？我的看法正好相反。ETH 这一段不是被错杀，而是相对更弱，而且让它变弱的原因还没消失。

Binance 现货数据（11/10 19:05 台北时间）：ETH 约 2,092，24 小时 -0.7%，区间 2,084–2,152；BTC 约 74,248（+0.2%），SOL 约 84.5（-1.6%）。以 Binance UTC 周线（台北时间周一 08:00 开收）看，上周 ETH 从 2,275 开盘、收在 2,127，跌约 6.5%，周内最低 2,060，是 8 月下旬以来的最低价。这是连续第五根周阴线，从 9 月底 2,727 的周收盘算，累计跌了约 22%。同一周 BTC 跌约 4.5%，SOL 跌约 8.5%。本周到目前 ETH 最低 2,083，还在 2,060 上方，但现价离 2,060 只剩约 1.5%。

再看 ETH/BTC：现在约 0.0282，本周盘中最低 0.02812，已经跌破上周低点 0.02815；上周周收 0.02842，是 7 月中旬以来最低的周收盘；9 月 21 日那周它还在 0.0326 开盘，七周跌了约 13.5%。也就是说，ETH 不只是跟着大盘跌，而是一路跑输 BTC。

资金面更直接。Farside 显示，美国现货 ETH ETF 最近 10 个交易日（10/27–11/9）有 9 天净流出，合计约 8.93 亿美元，其中 ETHA 就占了约 7.52 亿；11 月前六个交易日合计净流出约 5.50 亿，只有 11/4 净流入 5,300 万。本周一（11/9）单日又净流出约 1.85 亿，ETHA 占约 1.19 亿。合约这边，ETH 永续资金费率最近几期在 -0.008% 到 +0.010% 之间来回，11/9 有两期为负，11/10 三期都是小幅正值，整体接近中性。

ETHA quarterly report flags risks to corporate holdings | ETH falls back to around $2,050 | Wait for signs of a bottom before considering a trade

My stance is cautious and watchful. The quarterly report for the iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA), signed on November 6, warns in a section on “risks related to digital asset treasury companies” that businesses using financing proceeds to buy ETH could find it harder to raise funds if their own valuations decline. In a falling market, some companies could also face pressure to sell existing holdings. This is a risk scenario disclosed by the issuer to investors; it should not be read as BlackRock predicting that companies will sell their coins imminently, much less as confirmation that large-scale selling is already underway.

This is worth paying attention to because the market often simplifies publicly listed companies’ ETH holdings into a steady source of buying pressure. In practice, the transmission has two stages: when financing is readily available, companies adding to their holdings absorb circulating supply; if both share prices and crypto prices come under pressure, however, discounted financing or debt constraints could weaken that buying—or even amplify volatility. The ETHA report also mentions potential issues with highly concentrated holdings affecting network governance and validators. That, too, is a conditional risk, not evidence that governance is currently under anyone’s control.

When I checked Binance’s ETHUSDT 24-hour market data, the price was around $2,050, down about 3.8% over 24 hours, with an intraday low of 2,006 and a high of 2,136.77. This decline reflects current market action; its cause cannot be attributed to a November 6 quarterly report based on price alone. I’m more focused on whether the price can hold near 2,006 and, if it gets back above roughly 2,100, whether it can stay there. A sustained break below 2,006 could further weaken short-term risk appetite. Only a strong-volume recovery above 2,100 followed by a successful retest would make a rebound worth discussing; the area around 2,137 is the next supply zone to watch.

If I were trading this myself, I would sit out for now—not chase a short or buy the dip. My initial directional bias would be a conditional, small spot long. I would consider a trial position only if the price gets back above $2,100, holds there for at least an hour, and then retests that level without breaking below it; the position would be no more than 5% of my total capital. The first target would be around 2,137, where I would sell half and watch whether the rest could extend to 2,180. If the price falls back below 2,070 after entry, I would stop out. If it breaks below 2,006 first, the long plan is off—“plan” does not mean a trade has already been executed. If a company formally discloses a large disposal, ETF outflows persist, or broader market risk appetite clearly deteriorates, I would close the position proactively before the target is reached. Conversely, if companies report stable financing and holdings, and ETH holds above 2,137, I would reassess the position. Discipline matters more than prediction.

Sources: ETHA’s third-quarter 2026 Form 10-Q filed with the U.S. SEC; Binance ETHUSDT live 24-hour market data. #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

Why did Visa suddenly give Monad settlement privileges? Another route just opened up in the stablecoin market  
Visa added Monad to its stablecoin settlement options for institutional clients, giving institutions another officially approved way to use stablecoins  

Visa recently announced that it was giving Monad “settlement privileges,” allowing institutional clients involved in stablecoin transactions to settle through Monad. This means institutions will be able to process stablecoin trades through the Visa system openly and officially. Why Monad? It used to focus on cross-border remittances, and now it wants a piece of the stablecoin market. With this move, Visa is giving Monad access to a roster of major clients and offering institutions more options. Previously, they could only choose from a handful of mainstream stablecoins; now Monad can also use Visa’s network. Visa didn’t specify exactly which institutions will be able to use it, but presumably they’re monetary institutions that have already signed contracts with Visa.  

Impact on the market  
- In the short term, this probably won’t have much impact on stablecoins themselves, since it only adds another settlement channel without changing supply and demand. But over the long term, it could help Monad gain traction in the stablecoin space more quickly, although it’s still very small for now.  
- In the medium term, regulators have been working on new stablecoin rules, and bringing more players into the compliant fold is a positive trend. But for Monad to really take off, it still needs to prove its value—for example, whether it can offer lower costs than other settlement channels. The stablecoin market is still somewhat volatile, so institutions having one more option is better than having none.  

Don’t be too harsh if I got anything wrong—I’m just trying stablecoins with a small position myself 🎯

$ETH ’s spot ETFs are also starting to bleed. According to SoSoValue data, on Monday (November 9, U.S. Eastern Time), $ETH  spot ETFs saw net outflows of $185 million in a single day, marking their third consecutive day of outflows.

The familiar name topped the outflow list again: BlackRock’s ETHA saw $119 million flow out in one day. But it has deep pockets, with cumulative net inflows still totaling $11.4 billion. On the inflow side, only Morgan Stanley’s MSSE bucked the trend, taking in $1.6 million—a drop in the bucket compared with the outflows.

With BTC and ETH ETFs both bleeding, this isn’t about any one coin. It’s a broad move to “reduce exposure to risk assets”: amid macroeconomic uncertainty, institutions are trimming positions and waiting on the sidelines, ready to decide which way to go once key data like CPI comes out.

In the short term, this is a headwind. But seen another way, it’s inventory clearing out—when risk appetite returns, these channels are ready-made conduits for money to flow back in. The key question is: how much dry powder will you keep before the channels open?

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are the Fuel Costs of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay gas fees to transfer tokens or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring tokens, trading, running
a contract) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people rush to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the gas unit price).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → soaring gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

ETH Watch | U.S. stock tokenization agreement lands on Ethereum | Focus on execution, not hype

My stance is cautious: the partnership between Hawkeye Digital and Securitize is worth monitoring, but it is too early to treat an agreement as evidence that Ethereum has gained a measurable new inflow of funds. The 8-K Hawkeye filed with the U.S. SEC on November 6 states that the parties have reached an agreement under which shareholders may choose to have their existing common shares natively tokenized on Ethereum. The accompanying announcement further states that the tokenized shares are expected to be available to eligible investors only in 2027. What is confirmed here is an agreement and a plan—not a product launch, much less an announcement that the company has bought ETH.

In terms of how it works, this design is more worth watching than simply issuing a token that tracks a stock’s price: shareholders first transfer their shares from their brokerage accounts into the transfer agent’s direct registration system, complete identity verification and anti-money-laundering checks, and then choose whether to tokenize them. Holders can also transfer their shares back to book-entry registration through the prescribed process. The shares retain their original voting and dividend rights, and the common stock will continue to trade over the counter. If actual holders ultimately register, transfer, and settle shares on Ethereum, on-chain activity could increase, providing marginal support for ETH as the network’s fee asset. But the participation rate, trading frequency, and specific fee arrangements are all unknown, so this does not justify concluding that ETH demand will surge in the short term.

The market is not pricing this news in separately for now, either. ETH/USDT was around $2,058 on Binance, down about 3.0% over the past 24 hours, with a range of $2,006 to $2,137; KuCoin quoted around $2,058, broadly in line. The weak price action reminds me that macro risk appetite and fund flows remain more immediate drivers than a small-scale stock pilot expected to launch in 2027. On the upside, first watch whether ETH can regain and hold $2,080–$2,100, then the area around $2,137. On the downside, $2,006 is the intraday low; if it breaks, be wary of treating the narrative as support.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t go long on the strength of this agreement right now; I’d stay on the sidelines. Only if ETH climbs back above $2,100 and holds $2,080 on a retest would I consider a small spot long, with the first position capped at 5% of total funds and no leverage. I’d initially target $2,135–$2,140, take half off there, and target $2,180 for the remainder. If ETH falls back below $2,050 after entry, I’d stop out and close the position. If it breaks below $2,006 first, I’d cancel the long plan and wait for a stable range to form again. Even if the price breaks out, I’d reverse my medium-term bullish view if the project is delayed, on-chain adoption remains limited, or subsequent announcements show that settlement does not lead to visible Ethereum usage. I won’t present a plan as if it were already a completed trade.

Sources: Hawkeye’s November 6 SEC 8-K and Exhibit 99.1; market prices are Binance and KuCoin spot quotes taken before publication.
#ETH #Ethereum
This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH观察｜美股代币化协议落在以太坊｜先看落地，不追概念

我的态度偏谨慎：Hawkeye Digital与Securitize的合作值得跟踪，但现在还不能把一份协议当成以太坊已经获得可量化的新资金流入。Hawkeye在11月6日向美国SEC提交的8-K写明，双方已达成协议，拟让股东选择把现有普通股先在以太坊上原生代币化。随附公告进一步写明，相关代币化股票预计到2027年才可供符合资格的投资者使用。这里已经确认的是协议和计划，不是产品已经上线，更不是公司宣布买入ETH。

机制上，这种设计比单纯发行一个股票价格映射代币更值得观察：股东先把券商账户里的股份转至过户代理的直接登记体系，完成身份及反洗钱核验，再选择代币化；持有者还可以按程序转回账簿登记。股票原有的投票和分红权利保留，普通股继续在场外市场交易。如果最终有真实持有人在以太坊上登记、转让和结算，链上活动可能增加，对ETH作为网络费用资产有边际支持。但选择参与的比例、交易频率和具体费用路径都未知，不能据此推导出短期ETH需求暴增。

市场眼下也没有给这条消息单独定价。查看币安ETH/USDT时约2058美元，过去24小时跌约3.0%，区间2006至2137美元；KuCoin报价约2058美元，方向基本一致。弱势价格提醒我，宏观风险偏好和资金流仍比一项2027年预期落地的小规模股票试点更直接。上方先看2080至2100美元能否重新站稳，再看2137美元附近；下方2006美元是当日低位，跌破后应防止把叙事当成支撑。

如果是我自己交易，我现在不因这份协议追多，保持观望。只有ETH重新站上2100美元，并在回踩时守住2080美元，我才考虑现货试多，首笔不超过总资金的5%，不用杠杆；目标先看2135至2140美元，到位减半，余仓看2180美元。若入场后跌回2050美元下方就止损平仓；若先跌破2006美元，则取消多单计划，等待重新形成稳定区间。即便价格突破，如果项目进度推迟、链上采用率有限，或后续公告显示结算并不带来可见的以太坊使用量，我也会推翻中期利好判断，不把计划写成已经成交。

事实来源：SEC 11月6日Hawkeye 8-K及附件99.1；行情为发文前币安与KuCoin现货报价。

[Title: Forward Boosts Its SOL Reserves—Is the Crypto Market Bullish or Bearish?]

Forward Industries adds a $5 billion credit line to buy SOL, helping the crypto market stabilize this relentlessly falling coin.

This news is about Forward Industries, a derivatives company, raising money again. It has added a $5 billion credit line to its SOL reserves and plans to make an investment tied to housing. Why? Because SOL has fallen sharply recently, hitting a nearly three-month low of just $83.43, and the company wants to accumulate more while it’s cheap. The $5 billion is a credit line, not money they’re spending outright. That means if SOL keeps falling, they can use the funds to borrow money to buy the coin and support its price.

Impact on the market
- Short term: This is a boost to sentiment around SOL. If a well-resourced company like Forward is increasing its holdings, smaller retail investors and institutions will take notice. After all, when a company like this buys crypto, it sends a signal. But if SOL’s fundamentals don’t improve, other people buying it won’t be enough. Some capital may flow from other coins into SOL, especially since other coins have also fallen sharply—ETH is down 3.43%.
- Medium term: The industry landscape hasn’t really changed. Forward is doing this because it believes SOL has potential. But SOL’s recent poor performance shows it’s facing serious competition and pressure. What about regulatory trends? They’re not a factor here. Forward’s move doesn’t involve regulatory issues; it’s purely an investment decision.

My take
Honestly, moves like this in crypto can go either way. Forward’s buying could lift SOL a little off the floor in the short term, but over the long run, whether SOL can hold its ground depends on its own applications and ecosystem. At $83.43, SOL is at a level where even a well-resourced company like Forward is buying the dip, which shows confidence. But other investors should understand that this kind of move carries risks too. If SOL keeps falling, that money could go down the drain. The market is that brutal: every buyer needs a seller, and it comes down to who understands this coin better.

美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。

issuer. This “mint-and-redeem” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Being Flat Is Also a Position—and It’s the One the Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings grind their capital away.

In reality, being flat is the only position with zero losses. Stay flat when you don’t understand the market,
Staying flat when bulls and bears are battling it out, and staying flat after a string of bad trades—the money you save in these moments,
is more than most traders make.

You may be tired of the hunting metaphor, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. When you have capital, you’ll have ammunition when an opportunity comes along. Hold on to your ammunition.

Bitmine discloses purchase of 9,587 ETH | Spot still down nearly 4% | I’m waiting for confirmation at 2057

I accept institutional holdings as a fact, but I won’t treat one company’s purchase as a signal that the entire market has bottomed. In a company press release on November 9, attached to an 8-K filing with the SEC, Bitmine disclosed that as of 2 p.m. Eastern Time on November 8, it held 6,070,092 ETH, about 4.97% of the 122.2 million total supply it cited. Its chairman said the company purchased 9,587 ETH over the past week. The company also disclosed that it had staked 5,227,037 ETH, about 86% of its holdings. These are disclosed holdings and past purchases, not a new real-time buy order placed in the early hours today. The stated goal of reaching 5% is still a goal; 4.97% should not be described as having already achieved it. The report estimated the dollar value of its assets using an ETH price of $2,234 at the time, so that old quote should not be mistaken for the current price in this market move.

This disclosure affects the market through two channels. First, sustained corporate buying may absorb some of the circulating supply. Second, a large proportion of staked coins are not directly available for spot selling on exchanges in the short term. However, staked assets still carry withdrawal, operational, and price risks, and should not be understood as permanently locked up. The annualized staking yield cited by the company is a model estimate, not a full year’s profit already earned. More importantly, one company’s balance sheet is not the same as broad institutional fund flows: Farside recorded about $184.6 million in net outflows from U.S. spot ETH ETFs on November 9. For November 10, the individual entries were still dashes; the page’s aggregate figure of 0.0 should not be treated as a confirmed zero flow. Corporate buying and fund outflows can happen at the same time, so traders should watch for the next complete set of data rather than cherry-picking one side of the story.

The market reaction is weak so far. Before publication, ETHUSDT on Binance was around $2,052.66, down about 3.59% over 24 hours, with a range of $2,006.00 to $2,137.30. After rebounding from the overnight low, a 15-minute candle at 04:15 reached a high of $2,056.27, then returned to around $2,052 at 04:30. This recovery suggests there is support near $2,006, but it is not enough to show that Bitmine’s disclosure has reversed risk appetite. 2057 is the short-term confirmation level I’m watching, 2040 is the pullback zone to monitor, and 2006 is the day’s low. If the price breaks below 2006 and fails to recover, the short-term stabilization thesis is invalidated. If it moves above 2057 but quickly falls back below 2040, that brief rally should not be mistaken for a trend. U.S. October CPI rose 0.4% month over month, and the Fed still maintains a target rate of 3.75% to 4.00%; the macro environment will also affect ETF and other high-volatility asset positions.

If I were trading this myself, I would sit out for now and only consider a small spot position for a long trade; I would avoid high leverage. The entry trigger is a 15-minute candle closing above 2057, followed by a pullback on the next candle that holds above 2050. I would allocate 3% of my total capital; if the trigger does not occur, I would remain in cash. The first target is 2080, where I would take half off. I would watch 2110 for the remainder, but only if consecutive closes confirm the move and funding data do not continue to deteriorate. The initial stop-loss would be below 2038, with a maximum risk of 0.5% of total capital on the trade. After entry, if two 15-minute candles close back below 2050, I would exit proactively. If the price breaks below 2006 first, I would cancel this plan and wait for a new structure. A company disclosure is evidence, not an instruction that overrides my discipline.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

Bitmine披露增持9587枚ETH｜现货仍跌近4%｜我等2057确认

我的态度是认可机构持仓这个事实，但不会把一家公司买入当作全市场见底信号。Bitmine在11月9日通过公司发布稿并附于SEC的8-K文件披露，截至11月8日美东时间14时持有6,070,092枚ETH，占其所引122.2百万枚总供应量约4.97%；董事长称过去一周购入9587枚。公司同时披露已质押5,227,037枚ETH，约占其持仓86%。这是已披露的持仓与历史买入，不是今天凌晨新增的实时买单；所谓达到5%的目标仍是目标，4.97%不能写成已经完成。稿件以当时2234美元的ETH报价估算资产美元值，不能把旧报价误当本轮现价。

这项披露影响市场的机制有两层。第一，企业持续买入可能吸收部分流通供应；第二，大比例质押意味着这部分币短期没有直接放在交易所现货卖盘，但质押仍有提款、运营和价格风险，不能理解为永久锁仓。公司所称年化质押收益属于模型推算，不等于已经到手的全年利润。更关键的是，单家资产负债表与广泛机构申赎不相同：Farside记录11月9日美国ETH现货ETF净流出约1.846亿美元，11月10日各分项仍是横杠，页面汇总的0.0不能视作已确认零流量。企业买入和基金流出可以同时存在，交易者需要观察下一批完整数据而非只挑一边叙事。

市场反应目前偏弱。发文前币安ETHUSDT约2052.66美元，24小时跌约3.59%，区间2006.00至2137.30。凌晨低位反弹后，04:15一根15分钟K最高2056.27，04:30又回到2052附近；这个回升说明2006附近有承接，但不足以说明Bitmine披露扭转了风险偏好。2057是我观察的短线确认位，2040是回踩观察区，2006是当日低点。若连续跌破2006且收不回，短线企稳判断失效；若站上2057后很快回落到2040下方，也不能把短冲当趋势。美国10月CPI环比0.4%、美联储现仍维持3.75%至4.00%的目标利率，宏观环境同样会影响ETF与高波动资产仓位。

如果是我自己交易，现在先不参与，只考虑现货小仓试多，不碰高杠杆。入场触发是15分钟K收上2057，下一根回踩2050不破，计划投入总资金3%；没有触发就保持空仓。第一目标2080，触及先减半；剩余部分看2110，但必须以连续收盘和资金数据未继续恶化为前提。初始止损放在2038下方，单笔总资金风险上限0.5%；入场后若两根15分钟K收回2050下方，主动平仓。若先跌破2006，取消该计划，等新的结构。企业披露是证据，不是替代我执行纪律的指令。

#ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (execution), and
what you’ll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover that your losses…
There are many recurring “same types of mistakes” in your trade log—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or always closing profitable trades too early.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change automatically unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every principle. So I wrote them down and stuck them up where I can see them:

First: Write down your stop-loss level before opening a position. If you can’t, don’t open one.
Second: Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
Third: Never add to a losing position or average down.
Fourth: After three losing trades in a row, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
Fifth: Withdraw some of your profits. Taking money out helps keep your mindset in check.

That’s all five. Not one is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution falls apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly keep their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year turns your money into 12 times its original amount; earning a steady 10% a month,
turns it into 30 times its original amount in three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable quality—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities have to be waited for, but discipline is your own. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former comes from the market;
the ability behind the latter is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their capital are entitled to keep playing.

translatedData.content:
Glamsterdam risk review continues | ETH rebounds to 2043 | Wait for confirmation from both the audit and price action

My stance is cautious and defensive. The Ethereum Foundation supplemented its official November 6 statement on November 9: regarding EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 for Glamsterdam, the team has received four reports indicating that deployed contracts could be affected. It is reviewing them one by one and contacting the relevant protocol teams. Developers decided to pause the hard fork process on the Hoodi testnet while they clarify the security issues. This does not mean the mainnet has stopped operating, nor does it mean the upgrade has definitely been canceled. The next milestones are the audit report on November 13, a discussion on the 16th, and further deliberation on specification changes on the 19th; no final decision has been made. The key distinction is that “potential compatibility risks are under review,” not that “four protocols have been attacked.”

I see this as a public test of risk management in the Ethereum ecosystem. The two EIPs change how gas is priced for state creation and access. Some older contracts rely on the previous gas margin or failure-and-rollback paths; after the pricing changes, existing assumptions may no longer hold. Auditor ChainSecurity has outlined specific mechanisms, including failed calls and state gas refunds, while the Foundation has asked developers to check the relevant invariants. Delaying the testnet fork helps investigate the issues first, but also makes the upgrade timeline less certain. We shouldn't say ETH will benefit immediately just because “security comes first,” nor should we describe a testnet delay as an on-chain incident.

Flows and price have yet to point in a single direction. According to Farside's data, U.S. spot ETH ETFs saw net outflows of around $184.6 million on November 9. The entries for all products on November 10 are still blank, so the page's automatically calculated total of 0.0 should not be treated as confirmed zero flows. I checked Binance ETHUSDT at around $2,043, down about 3.9% over 24 hours. It hit an overnight low of $2,006, then rebounded to around $2,049 before returning to $2,043. The price recovery may partly reflect short-term position covering, and there is no verifiable direct causal link to the Foundation's security review. The trending hashtag #HotCPIDecemberHikePriced is also affecting risk appetite: the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported a 0.4% month-over-month rise in October CPI, but the Fed has not yet decided on its December policy.

The price levels I'm watching are $2,006, $2,025, $2,050, $2,080, and $2,120. $2,006 was last night's actual low; $2,025 is a nearby pullback zone during the rebound; and $2,050 is a resistance level that needs confirmation from trading volume. If price falls below $2,006 again and cannot quickly recover, my rebound thesis is invalidated. I would become more confident in a recovery only if price holds above $2,050, subsequent end-of-day ETF data improves, and the November 13 audit report does not expand the scope of the issues. Until any of these conditions materialize, I won't price future conclusions in advance.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now; the only direction I'd consider is a leveraged-free spot long. The conditions are two complete 15-minute candles closing above $2,050, followed by a pullback to the $2,035–$2,040 zone that holds. Only then would I enter in two tranches, using no more than 2.5% of my total capital. The first target is $2,080, where I'd take half off; the second is $2,120, where I'd reduce the position to a small watch position. I'd set the initial stop below $2,004. If price falls back below $2,035 after entry and rebounds weakly, I'd close early. If $2,006 breaks decisively first, I'd cancel the plan. If the security report reveals significant new risks, I'd exit and reassess even if price briefly spikes. The maximum loss budget for a single trade is 0.2% of total capital; I won't use leverage to gamble on the audit outcome.

Glamsterdam风险核查延续｜ETH反弹至2043｜先等审计与价格双确认

我的态度是谨慎偏防守。以太坊基金会11月6日的官方说明在11月9日补充：围绕Glamsterdam的EIP-8037与EIP-8038，团队已收到四份指向已部署合约可能受影响的报告，正逐一审查并联系协议方。开发者决定暂缓Hoodi测试网的硬分叉流程，等待安全问题厘清；这不是主网已经停摆，也不是已经确定取消升级。后续节点是11月13日公布审计报告、16日讨论、19日再议规范调整，尚无最终决定。关键边界是“潜在兼容性风险正在核查”，不是“四个协议已经被攻击”。

我把这件事看作以太坊生态风险管理的一次公开检验。两项EIP调整状态创建与访问的gas计价，某些旧合约依赖原有gas余量或失败回滚路径；计价变化后，既有假设可能失效。审计方ChainSecurity给出了失败调用、状态gas返还等具体机制，基金会则要求开发者核对相关不变量。推迟测试网分叉有助于先排查问题，也增加了升级时间表的不确定性。不能因为“安全优先”就说ETH马上受益，也不能把测试网延期直接写成链上事故。

资金与价格暂未给出单一方向。Farside汇总的美国ETH现货ETF在11月9日净流出约1.846亿美元，11月10日各产品栏仍是空白，页面自动合计0.0不能当作已确认的零流量。我查看币安ETHUSDT约2043美元，24小时约跌3.9%，昨夜低点2006，随后反弹至2049附近又回到2043。价格回升可能包含短线回补，与基金会发布的安全核查没有可验证的直接因果。广场热门的#HotCPIDecemberHikePriced也在影响风险偏好：劳工统计局公布10月CPI环比0.4%，但美联储12月政策尚未决定。

我的价格观察位是2006、2025、2050、2080和2120美元。2006是昨夜真实低点，2025是反弹中的近端回踩区，2050是上方需要成交确认的关口；若重新跌破2006且无法迅速收回，反弹判断推翻。若站稳2050、ETF后续日终数据改善，并且13日审计报告没有扩大问题范围，我才会提高对修复走势的信心。任何一项尚未发生时，都不先把未来结论写进价格。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与；方向只考虑无杠杆现货试多。条件是两根完整15分钟K线收在2050上方，再回踩2035至2040区域不破；满足才以总资金不超过2.5%分两笔进入。第一目标2080，触及减半；第二目标2120，再减至小额观察仓。初始止损设在2004下方；若入场后跌回2035且反弹无力，提前平仓。若2006先被有效跌破，取消计划；若安全报告披露重大新风险，即使价格短时上冲也先退出重新评估。账户单次损失预算不超过总资金0.2%，不靠杠杆赌审计结果。

title: Взлом Binance: почему хакеры отмывали деньги через мемкоины
subTitle:
Северокорейские хакеры выпустили шесть мемкоинов в сети NEAR, чтобы замаскировать движение средств, похищенных при взломе Binance. Через новые токены злоумышленники провели около $430 000. Вместо прямых переводов между кошельками хакеры использовали пулы ликвидности на децентрализованных биржах. Руководитель направления развития бизнеса в России и Беларуси компании ЦИФКОМ Анаита Андикхоу объясняет, почему была выбрана именно эта схема.

Руководитель направления развития бизнеса в России и Беларуси компании ЦИФКОМ Анаита Андикхоу
Зачем хакеры создают собственные мемкоины
По данным Elliptic, с 5 по 7 ноября злоумышленники выпустили как минимум шесть токенов в сети NEAR. Одни подконтрольные им кошельки покупали монеты за украденную криптовалюту, другие продавали их обратно через те же пулы и получали реальные активы.

Динамика цены мемкоинов, которые хакеры из КНДР использовали для отмывания средств. Источник: Elliptic.
Таким образом, средства перемещались между адресами не напрямую, а под видом обычных торговых операций. Большинство сделок совершили кошельки, связанные с одной сетью. После завершения операций токены перестали торговаться.
Анаита Андикхоу отмечает, что цель такой схемы не в заработке на мемкоинах, а в маскировке происхождения средств.
«Вместо прямого перевода между кошельками они проводят встречные сделки через пул ликвидности. Это позволяет усложнить отслеживание происхождения активов», – пояснила эксперт.
При этом преступникам не нужно поддерживать рыночную цену токена или привлекать сторонних покупателей. Они контролируют предложение монеты и основную часть ликвидности. Один кошелек покупает токены за украденную криптовалюту, другой продает заранее полученные монеты.
При согласованном выполнении операций хакеры могут сохранить большую часть стоимости активов. Основные потери приходятся на комиссии и проскальзывание – разницу между ожидаемой и фактической ценой сделки.

Схема отмывания средств, похищенных при взломе Binance. Источник: Elliptic.
Почему хакеры не используют Monero
Для сокрытия происхождения криптовалюты можно использовать приватные монеты, например Monero. Однако у такого подхода есть ограничения: ликвидность подобных активов может быть недостаточной для крупных сумм, а их последующая конвертация создает дополнительные сложности.
Собственный токен позволяет обойтись без промежуточной приватной криптовалюты. Хакеры самостоятельно создают монету, контролируют ее предложение и организуют сделки между подконтрольными адресами.
При этом такая схема не делает транзакции анонимными. Все операции по-прежнему записываются в блокчейне. По словам Андикхоу, задача злоумышленников – не полностью скрыть движение средств, а усложнить установление экономических связей между кошельками и выиграть время.
Как биржи могут распознать отмывание через мемкоины
Обычной проверки адресов недостаточно, чтобы выявить подобную схему. Криптобиржам необходимо анализировать происхождение ликвидности, взаимосвязи участников торгов и движение резервов в пулах.
Особенно подозрительно выглядит ситуация, когда почти весь оборот недавно созданного токена приходится на взаимосвязанные кошельки. Формально операции могут выглядеть как независимые сделки, хотя фактически их участники действуют согласованно.
При этом заранее установить, что конкретный кошелек принадлежит северокорейским хакерам, зачастую невозможно. Поэтому эффективнее отслеживать связанные с ними финансовые потоки и инфраструктуру.
«Главная проблема для AML-систем – не отсутствие данных, а способность восстановить экономическую связь между операциями, которые формально выглядят независимыми», – заключила Андикхоу.
Ранее Elliptic сообщила, что аналогичный прием северокорейские хакеры применяли после взлома Bybit в 2025 году. Тогда через самостоятельно созданный токен в сети Tron они провели не менее $24 млн.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Hold on to a Losing Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% looking at? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Be careful: this thought is driven entirely by attachment, not logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

After entering a position, you automatically seek out positive news and filter out negative news. This is called confirmation bias. You start to think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “what would invalidate the logic behind this trade,”
and act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate decision-making from holding a position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t an Admission of Failure—it’s the Price of Admission for Your Next Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you buy in advance, and the small loss is the premium.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever seen cut their losses more decisively than anyone. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong

Dormant address moves funds｜2,154.95 ETH sent to a new address｜I don’t treat transfers as sell-offs

My stance is to watch cautiously, not to label an on-chain transfer a “whale dump.” Binance News reported that an early Ethereum address dormant for about 11.3 years transferred 0.05 ETH at 06:04 Beijing time on November 10 and still held about 2,154.95 ETH at the time of reporting. That was a snapshot at the time. I checked public blockchain explorers: the original address, 0x7dDd…59Bc, subsequently transferred about 2,154.9495 ETH to the same address at around 06:42; its current balance is about 0.00044 ETH. The destination address, 0x1321…31A44, still holds about 2,154.9995 ETH. Moving funds out of the original address does not mean they went to an exchange, much less that they were sold. The address controller and purpose have not been established.

Movement of a large, long-dormant balance can make traders worry about potential supply, but it could also be wallet consolidation or a security migration. Without exchange labels or records of subsequent trades, neither explanation can be stated as fact. I’ll track whether the destination address sends funds to a clearly labeled exchange address. There isn’t enough evidence to predict that ETH must fall just because the original address’s balance has dropped to nearly zero. Treating “still holds 2,154.95 ETH” at 06:04 as the current balance would also be misleading.

The macro backdrop still matters. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that the seasonally adjusted overall CPI rose 0.4% month over month in October, while core CPI rose 0.3%. Most year-over-year figures could not be provided because October 2025 data were missing. The Binance Square topic #HotCPIDecemberHikePriced continues to gain traction, and ETH is also among the six-hour Most Searched. This hot topic reflects market expectations, not a decision already made by the Federal Reserve for December. On ETF flows, Farside lists a combined net outflow of about $184.6 million from U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs on November 9; data for individual products on November 10 have not yet been entered. A blank does not mean the final flow was zero. Macro expectations, ETF flows, and on-chain address movements are separate pieces of evidence and should not be strung together into a causal story presented as proven.

Price action also doesn’t support the simplistic narrative of a one-way crash after the transfer. ETHUSDT on Binance dipped to 2,006 at 23:30, then rebounded to 2,038.70, revisited 2,009.58 at 00:30, and was around $2,028 at the time of writing, down about 4.6% over the rolling 24 hours. The transfer took place earlier, at 06:42; evening volatility also coincided with news such as the CPI report, so it cannot be explained by a single transfer. My key levels are 2,006, 2,020, 2,039, and 2,065: a break below 2,006 followed by a failed rebound above 2,020 would strengthen my cautious view; a sustained recovery above 2,039 would only ease short-term pressure, while holding above 2,065 would be a more meaningful recovery. If subsequent on-chain data show the destination address remains inactive and the price holds above 2,065, I’ll be less concerned about potential selling pressure.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t enter now; I’d only consider a small long position in ETH spot after confirmation. The trigger would be two complete 15-minute candles closing above 2,065, followed by a pullback that holds near 2,050, while the destination address shows no verifiable transfer to an exchange. If these conditions are met, I’d open a trial position using 3% of total capital, without high leverage. I’d take half off at 2,085 and most of the rest at 2,110; the initial stop-loss would be below 1,998. If, after entry, the price falls back below 2,039 and continues to close weakly, I’d exit early. If it breaks below 2,006 before entry, I’d cancel the plan. The on-chain signal is only a filter. The previous plan was never triggered, so it must not be described as a trade.

沉睡地址已转出｜2154.95枚ETH进入新地址｜我不把转账当抛售

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把链上转账直接写成“巨鲸砸盘”。币安新闻报道，一个沉睡约11.3年的以太坊早期地址在北京时间11月10日06:04转出0.05枚ETH，报道时仍持有约2154.95枚。这是当时快照。我核对公开链上浏览器：原地址0x7dDd…59Bc随后在06:42左右又向同一地址转出约2154.9495枚，原址现余额约0.00044枚；目标地址0x1321…31A44仍约持有2154.9995枚。从原址移出不等于流入交易所，更不等于已卖出。地址控制人和目的未获证明。

大额长期未动资金移动，会让交易者担心潜在供给；但也可能是钱包整理或安全迁移。缺少交易所标签和后续成交记录，两种解释都不能写成事实。我会跟踪目标地址是否转往明确标记的交易所地址。仅凭原址余额归零预测ETH必跌，证据不足。把06:04的“还有2154.95枚”当成当前余额，也会误导判断。

宏观背景依然重要。美国劳工统计局公布10月CPI季调环比整体上涨0.4%、核心上涨0.3%，多数同比数据因2025年10月资料缺口无法提供。币安广场#HotCPIDecemberHikePriced仍在上升，ETH也在六小时Most Searched内。这个热题表达市场预期，而非美联储已经作出12月决定。ETF资金方面，Farside列出的11月9日美国现货以太坊ETF合计净流出约1.846亿美元，11月10日各产品数据仍未填报；空白不等于最终零流量。宏观预期、ETF申赎与链上地址移动是不同证据，不能串成一个已经证实的因果故事。

价格反应也没有支持“转账后单边崩盘”的简单叙事。币安ETHUSDT在23:30曾探至2006，之后反弹到2038.70，00:30又回探2009.58，截稿约2028美元，滚动24小时约跌4.6%。转账发生在更早的06:42，晚间波动还叠加CPI等消息，无法由一笔转账单独解释。我的关键位是2006、2020、2039和2065：跌破2006且反抽无法重回2020，谨慎判断加强；连续收回2039只是短线缓和，站稳2065才是更有意义的修复。若链上后续显示目标地址继续静置、价格站稳2065，我会降低对潜在抛压的担忧。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与；方向仅考虑确认后的ETH现货小仓位做多。触发是两根完整15分钟K线收在2065上方，回踩2050附近守住，同时目标地址没有出现可核验的交易所转入；满足后以总资金3%试仓，不用高杠杆。目标2085先减半，2110再减大部分；初始止损放在1998下方。若进场后重新跌回2039并连续收弱，我会提前平仓；若入场前跌穿2006，则取消计划。链上信号只是过滤条件。旧计划未触发，不能写成成交。

ETH Staking ETF quarterly filing reveals holdings | 76.4% of assets participating in staking | I’m waiting for confirmation from both flows and price

My stance is to view institutional ETH staking cautiously. I wouldn’t infer that there’s new buying today just because a fund holds a large amount of ETH. BlackRock’s iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF filed a quarterly report with the SEC showing that, as of September 30, approximately 337,045 ETH was staked through a third party, accounting for 76.4% of the fund’s ETH holdings at the time; the fair value of its ETH investments was approximately $1.189 billion. This is a snapshot of holdings at the end of September, not new staking today. Staking income of approximately $3.067 million was recorded for the third quarter, net of service fees. The fund’s price returns and staking income come from two different sources, and operational risks must also be considered. I’ve previously discussed Grayscale’s staking fund; this time, I’m focusing on the actual staking ratio of BlackRock’s product.

In principle, staking ETFs package on-chain validation rewards into brokerage accounts, potentially attracting investors who don’t operate wallets directly. At the same time, managers must coordinate available ETH, redemptions, and third-party services. Growth in shares outstanding can drive demand for ETH, but the September-end ratio alone cannot prove ETF net inflows today. In Farside’s November 10 ETH fund table, several products were still missing reports, leaving the preliminary total at approximately negative $2 million; this is not a complete market-wide figure. We should wait for all funds to report and then assess whether the trend is sustained. Popular topics on Plaza centered on CPI, BTC’s weekly decline, and corporate holdings. ETH appeared under Most Searched but not Rapid Riser; I’m keeping only the ETH token tag.

The market reaction should also be assessed separately. When checked, Binance ETHUSDT was around $2,068.64, down approximately 2.35% over 24 hours, with a high of around $2,132.07 and a low of $2,006. The market did not strengthen directly in response to historical quarterly figures, suggesting that short-term macro factors and risk appetite remain dominant. U.S. CPI rose 0.4% month over month in October, while core CPI rose 0.3%; on October 28, the Federal Reserve kept its target interest rate at 3.75% to 4.00%. These figures cannot be used to claim with certainty what the Fed will decide at its next meeting. The Ethereum Foundation’s Glamsterdam compatibility review is part of a separate technical process and should not be conflated with same-day cash flows into staking ETFs. My view is that structural demand for staking products is more likely to be confirmed by price if complete ETF data subsequently turns positive and ETH climbs back above key levels. If the price falls below $2,006, the short-term thesis should be abandoned.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now. I’d only consider a conditional spot long, with a maximum position size of 4% of total capital. I’d wait for ETH to hold above $2,100 on the one-hour timeframe and then retest $2,080 without breaking below it before opening a 2% test position. If it then breaks above $2,132 with volume following through, I’d increase the position to no more than 4%. The first target would be $2,180; I’d take half off there and use $2,100 as the protective level for the remainder. The initial stop-loss would be below $2,040. If the price first breaks below $2,006, I’d cancel the long plan and close any existing positions rather than averaging down. I’d cap the preset loss on any single trade at 0.5% of total capital and avoid high leverage. If future fund disclosures show a sharp drop in the staking ratio, restrictions on creations or redemptions, or persistently weakening complete flow data, I’d abandon the bullish thesis. If the conditions aren’t met, I’ll stay out of the market rather than present monitoring as a completed trade.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH质押ETF季报披露仓位｜76.4%资产参与质押｜我等资金与价格双确认

我的态度是审慎看待ETH机构化质押，不因为基金持有大量ETH就推断今天有新买盘。贝莱德旗下iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF向SEC提交的截至9月30日季报显示，该基金约337045枚ETH通过第三方参与质押，占当时ETH持仓的76.4%；ETH投资公允价值约11.89亿美元。这是9月底的存量截面，不是今天新增质押。第三季度约306.7万美元质押收入，按扣除服务费后的净额确认。基金价格回报与质押收益是两条不同来源，也要考虑运营风险。此前已谈过灰度质押基金，本次关注贝莱德产品的实际质押比例。

机制上，质押ETF把链上验证收益包装进证券账户，可能吸引不直接操作钱包的资金；同时，管理人必须协调可用ETH、赎回与第三方服务。份额扩张能够带来ETH需求，但不能仅凭9月底比例证明今天ETF净流入。Farside的11月10日ETH基金表里，多只产品仍缺报，暂时合计约负200万美元；这不是完整市场总额。应等各基金补齐，再看连续性。广场热门话题集中在CPI、BTC周跌、企业持仓，Most Searched有ETH但并非Rapid Riser；只保留ETH币种标签。

市场反应也要单独看。币安ETHUSDT查看时约2068.64美元，24小时约跌2.35%，高低约2132.07与2006美元。行情没有因为历史季报数字直接走强，说明短线宏观和风险偏好仍占主导。美国10月CPI环比0.4%、核心环比0.3%，美联储10月28日维持3.75%至4.00%的目标利率；不能用这些数据断言下一次会议必然如何决策。以太坊基金会的Glamsterdam兼容性审查也处于另一条技术进程，不能混同为质押ETF当日现金流。我的判断是：如果后续ETF完整数据转正且ETH重新站上关键位，质押产品的结构性需求才更可能得到价格印证；若价格失守2006美元，短线判断就应撤销。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只准备条件性现货多单，总资金仓位上限4%。ETH先在一小时级别站稳2100美元，并回踩不破2080美元，我才用2%试仓；若再突破2132美元且成交跟上，最多加至4%。首个目标看2180美元，到位减半，余仓以2100美元为保护位；初始止损设在2040美元下方。如果先跌破2006美元，取消多头计划，已有仓位全部平掉，不通过加仓摊低成本。单次预设亏损控制在总资金0.5%以内，不用高杠杆。若基金后续披露质押比例大降、申赎受限或完整资金数据持续走弱，我会推翻偏多假设。未触发条件就维持空仓，不把观察写成成交。

title: 利好全给了，币价没认
subTitle:
这周币圈的利好，多到有点奢侈。

Coinbase 拿到了美国国民信托银行牌照，周五生效，联邦监管下的合规托管——这消息放到两年前，够拉一根大阳线。中期选举民主党把参众两院全拿下了，监管转向的预期摆上了桌。稳定币立法、ETF 期权、托管放开，随便拎一条出来，都够写三篇稿子。

结果呢？BTC 跌 1%，ETH 跌 2.4%，盘中还去摸了一下 2,000。

A couple of days ago, I talked about Anthropic going all-in on Lambda. Now Circle has jumped in, ready to be an ATM for AI. The U.S. stablecoin giant recently said its USDC is especially well suited for AI agents to spend—for example, buying software, paying for services, or even settling payments for businesses. The basic reason is that the AI industry burns through cash, so it needs a reliable wallet to handle payments. AI companies are constantly testing things and using services; without stablecoins, converting every transaction into fiat currency would be a hassle. Circle's point is that USDC can give AI a stable, transparent way to pay. Put simply, it's looking to capture a new market at the start of the AI boom.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this could make investors think stablecoins have found another use case. Over the long term, if AI really starts using USDC at scale, the market may see stablecoin demand growing again. As for prices, I looked at the data, and this could have a more direct impact on ETH. title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Take Losses to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s run the numbers】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 losses in a row, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down only 20%, a few winning trades can get you back. But if you go all-in each time and lose 30%,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—the math has practically written you off.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%”; it’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
doesn’t exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work out the position size.

Who ultimately executes a contract written in Solidity?
The EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) is the virtual machine that executes Ethereum smart contracts. Every node executes the same contract code according to the same rules.
Here's the key point: Before interacting with a contract, check on a block explorer whether its source code has been verified. Be especially cautious with contracts whose source code isn't public.
When you call a contract on Ethereum, the EVM counts Gas for every step it executes, paid using $ETH . Current: 2064.18.
If you're unfamiliar with something, don't go in with a large position. Practice with a small amount first.

#ETH
